qualification.status: Frozen after calibration, before reference qualification
notes: The proposed numerical budgets from the plan are retained without relaxation.

Cohort B primary timings are retained. Its paced RAF timeline intervals can hide delayed callback arrival. Cohort C repeats all paced cases using actual performance.now callback arrival gaps, with RAF timeline intervals and lateness retained separately. A 45 ms injected-stall check guards the frame metric.

Primary cohort A receiver callback cost is explicit JavaScript decode/cache application. Follow-up cohort B separately times MessageEvent.data access and the whole receiver callback, including request bookkeeping and explicit decode/application; this observed receiver timer may still exclude earlier browser-internal work. Host round trips and frame intervals include delivery.
Input-to-visible is sampled synthetic intent through applied-tick acknowledgement and the next presentation callback; physical input-to-photon and full-game rendering remain unqualified.
120 Hz is timer-emulated diagnostic pacing, not physical-display qualification.
Calibration-01 and all development smoke cohorts are excluded from reference ranking.

The planned cohort A worker-clock scheduler polls 49 ms after reply completion; those cases were not executed after the cadence confound was identified. Cohort B paired clocks poll from the prior dispatch, retaining one outstanding request. Cohort B repeats target qualification without pooling A samples; its clock diagnostics remain separate.
Cohort A replaced the warmed worker before measurement. Cohort B retains the worker and replaces only the disposable world; corrected target qualification uses B only.
Follow-up protocol checks explicitly acknowledge queued command cancellation on suspension and test new commands after restoration. Numerical qualification gates remain unchanged.
